```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
library(terra)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

beauty.palette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")),space="Lab")

RSIIB1.projections<-rast("RSIIB1Projections.tif")
RSIIB1.Maxent<-rast("RSIIB1MaxENT.tif")
RSIIB1.Maxent<-RSIIB1.Maxent#^(1/2)
RSIIB1.projections<-list(RSIIB1.projections, RSIIB1.Maxent)
RSIIB1.projections<-terra::rast(RSIIB1.projections)
ensemble.RSIIB1<-mean(RSIIB1.projections[[c(1,2,3,4)]])
writeRaster(ensemble.RSIIB1,"RSIIB-1-ensemble.tif",overwrite=TRUE)

countries <- vect(ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf"))
countries <- project(countries, crs(ensemble.RSIIB1))

oceans <- vect(ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "ocean", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf"))
oceans <- project(oceans, crs(ensemble.RSIIB1))

lakes <- vect(ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "lakes", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf"))
lakes <- project(lakes, crs(ensemble.RSIIB1))

geo.presence <- read.csv("C:/Users/plexaaron/UFL Dropbox/Aaron Plex Sula/168/2022/2022 Projects/Pathogen biogeography/Model validation/Ralstonia solanacearum/Ralstonia_Global_Diversity_Current_7_29.csv")
geo.presence<-geo.presence[geo.presence$Sequevar == "1",]
ncountries <- unique(geo.presence$Location..Country.or.Territory.)
geo.presence <- geo.presence[!geo.presence$Location.Isolated %in% ncountries,]
geo.presence <- geo.presence[, c("Latitude", "Longitude")]
geo.presence <- geo.presence[!duplicated(geo.presence[, c("Longitude", "Latitude")]), ]
vectorPresence<-vect(geo.presence, 
                 crs="+proj=longlat", geom=c("Longitude","Latitude"))
vectorPresence<-project(vectorPresence, crs(ensemble.RSIIB1))
```


```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8, dpi=250}
plot(countries, col = "grey5",  xaxt='n',  yaxt='n', axes=F, box=F, legend = F, border = NA, 
     main = "Ralstonia solanacearum phylotype IIB1 (RSIIB1, n = 151)")
plot(oceans, col = "lightblue", border = NA, add = T)
plot(RSIIB1.Maxent^(2/3), col=beauty.palette(100), xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', axes = F, box = F, add = T, legend = T, 
     plg = list(loc = "bottom", horizontal = TRUE, cex = 1.5))
plot(lakes, col = "lightblue", border = NA, add = T)
plot(countries, add = T, border = "grey50", lwd = 0.5)
plot(vectorPresence, pch = 0, cex = 0.6, col = "grey35", add = TRUE)
```

## Invasion risk based on rivers

River data from HydroATLAS (https://www.hydrosheds.org/hydroatlas)
hydrological connectivity

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8, dpi=250}
rivers<-rast("global-mean-rivers01.tif")
rivers<-project(rivers, crs(ensemble.RSIIB1))
rivers<-resample(rivers, ensemble.RSIIB1, method = "bilinear")
rivers.climate <- (rivers^0.05) * (ensemble.RSIIB1^0.75)

plot(countries, col = "grey5",  xaxt='n',  yaxt='n', axes=F, box=F, legend = F, border = NA, 
     main = "Mean discharge of all rivers")
plot(oceans, col = "lightblue", border = NA, add = T)
plot(rivers^0.15, col=beauty.palette(100), xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', axes = F, box = F, add = T, legend = T, 
     plg = list(loc = "bottom", horizontal = TRUE, cex = 1.5))
plot(lakes, col = "lightblue", border = NA, add = T)
plot(countries, add = T, border = "grey50", lwd = 0.5)

plot(countries, col = "grey5",  xaxt='n',  yaxt='n', axes=F, box=F, legend = F, border = NA, 
     main = "Ralstonia solanacearum phylotype IIB1 (RSIIB1, n = 151)")
plot(oceans, col = "lightblue", border = NA, add = T)
plot(rivers.climate, col=beauty.palette(100), xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', axes = F, box = F, add = T, legend = T, 
     plg = list(loc = "bottom", horizontal = TRUE, cex = 1.5))
plot(lakes, col = "lightblue", border = NA, add = T)
plot(countries, add = T, border = "grey50", lwd = 0.5)
plot(vectorPresence, pch = 0, cex = 0.6, col = "grey35", add = TRUE)
```


## Temperature tolerance model

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8, dpi=250}
temp1<-rast("https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/monthly/tas/CHELSA_tas_01_2019_V.2.1.tif")
temp2<-rast("https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/monthly/tas/CHELSA_tas_02_2019_V.2.1.tif")
temp3<-rast("https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/monthly/tas/CHELSA_tas_03_2019_V.2.1.tif")
temp4<-rast("https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/monthly/tas/CHELSA_tas_04_2019_V.2.1.tif")
temp5<-rast("https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/monthly/tas/CHELSA_tas_05_2019_V.2.1.tif")
temp6<-rast("https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/monthly/tas/CHELSA_tas_06_2019_V.2.1.tif")
temp7<-rast("https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/monthly/tas/CHELSA_tas_07_2019_V.2.1.tif")
temp8<-rast("https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/monthly/tas/CHELSA_tas_08_2019_V.2.1.tif")
temp9<-rast("https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/monthly/tas/CHELSA_tas_09_2019_V.2.1.tif")
temp10<-rast("https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/monthly/tas/CHELSA_tas_10_2019_V.2.1.tif")
temp11<-rast("https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/monthly/tas/CHELSA_tas_11_2019_V.2.1.tif")
temp12<-rast("https://os.zhdk.cloud.switch.ch/chelsav2/GLOBAL/monthly/tas/CHELSA_tas_12_2019_V.2.1.tif")

temperature<-list(temp1, temp2, temp3, temp4, temp5, temp6,
                  temp7, temp8, temp9, temp10, temp11, temp12)
temperature<-rast(temperature)
temperature<-aggregate(temperature, fact = 20, fun = mean, na.rm=TRUE)
values(temperature)<-values(temperature)/10-273.15

# Minimum temperature tolerance
Tmin<-10
# Maximum temperature tolerance
Tmax<-40
# Optimum temperature
Topt<-(20+28)/2
# Infection risk based on a beta distribution model
#factor1 <- (Tmax-temperature)/(Tmax-Topt)
#factor2 <- ((temperature-Tmin)/(Topt-Tmin))^((Topt-Tmin)/(Tmax-Topt))
#infection.risk <- factor1 * factor2 * ensemble.RSIIB1 * 1.190277
values(temperature) <- (Tmax-values(temperature))/(Tmax-Topt) * ((values(temperature)-Tmin)/(Topt-Tmin))^((Topt-Tmin)/(Tmax-Topt))
global.ext <- ext(-179, 179, -59, 83)
temperature <- crop(temperature, global.ext)

infection.risk1 <- sum(temperature, na.rm = TRUE)
infection.risk1 <- project(infection.risk1, crs(ensemble.RSIIB1))

infection.risk2 <- sum(temperature>0, na.rm = TRUE)
infection.risk2 <- project(infection.risk2, crs(ensemble.RSIIB1))

climate.temp1 <- rivers.climate^(0.75) * infection.risk1/12
climate.temp2 <- rivers.climate^(0.75) * infection.risk2/12

plot(countries, col = "grey5",  xaxt='n',  yaxt='n', axes=F, box=F, legend = F, border = NA, 
     main = "# months with temperature tolerated by \nRalstonia solanacearum phylotype IIB1 (RSIIB1)")
plot(oceans, col = "lightblue", border = NA, add = T)
plot(infection.risk1, col=beauty.palette(100), xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', axes = F, box = F, add = T, legend = T, 
     plg = list(loc = "bottom", horizontal = TRUE, cex = 1.5))
plot(lakes, col = "lightblue", border = NA, add = T)
plot(countries, add = T, border = "grey50", lwd = 0.5)
plot(vectorPresence, pch = 0, cex = 0.6, col = "grey45", add = TRUE)

plot(countries, col = "grey5",  xaxt='n',  yaxt='n', axes=F, box=F, legend = F, border = NA, 
     main = "Ralstonia solanacearum phylotype IIB1 (RSIIB1, n = 151)")
plot(oceans, col = "lightblue", border = NA, add = T)
plot(climate.temp1^(0.85), col=beauty.palette(100), xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', axes = F, box = F, add = T, legend = T, 
     plg = list(loc = "bottom", horizontal = TRUE, cex = 1.5))
plot(lakes, col = "lightblue", border = NA, add = T)
plot(countries, add = T, border = "grey50", lwd = 0.5)
plot(vectorPresence, pch = 0, cex = 0.6, col = "grey35", add = TRUE)
```
